search_images_using_query: search for images online using a specific query string and return thumbnail URLs
search_images_with_filters: search images using size, type, and layout filters to narrow results
search_images_for_generation: search for reference images before generating character or scene images
search_images_large_photos: search for large photo-type images with wide layout for visual references
search_images_custom_count: search images with a custom max_results count to control the number of returned results
